description: This PHP source file defines the class OX_Extension_DeliveryLog_AggregateBucketProcessingStrategyMysqli, which implements data migration and pruning strategies for aggregate buckets in a MySQL environment within the Revive Adserver project. It handles processing and pruning of data from specific database tables related to delivery log aggregation.

classes.name: OX_Extension_DeliveryLog_AggregateBucketProcessingStrategyMysqli
classes.description: A class implementing MySQL-specific strategies for processing and pruning aggregate delivery log buckets, including data migration and cleanup functionalities.

methods.name: processBucket
methods.description: Processes an aggregate bucket by migrating data up to a specified end date, handling duplicate entries, and disabling binary logging during insertion.

methods.name: pruneBucket
methods.description: Prunes (deletes) records from a bucket table up to a specified end date, optionally within a start date range.

methods.name: getBucketTableContent
methods.description: Retrieves the content of a bucket table as a recordset for processing.
